master.definition_en: A disorder caused by hantaviruses of the family Bunyaviridae. It is transmitted by rodents and is manifested with fever, hemorrhage, and renal failure. Other symptoms include headaches, abdominal and back pain, and blurred vision.

curated.name_zh: 肾综合征出血热（流行性出血热）
curated.category: 急症与罕见高危传染病 (High-Consequence Infectious Disease)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 汉坦病毒感染引起全身小血管与毛细血管内皮损伤，典型经“发热期-低血压休克期-少尿期-多尿期-恢复期”五期演变；可于起病数日至1周内突发难治性低血压休克、急性肾衰竭、消化道大出血或肺水肿致死；规范救治下国内病死率现已降至1%–3%以下。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽无极高效抗汉坦病毒特效靶向药，但早期“三早一就”（早发现、早休息、早治疗、就近治疗）抗休克、防肺水肿及少尿期血液透析过渡绝大多数患者可完全康复、肾功能恢复正常。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球死因不单列HFRS条目；全球大多数HFRS病例集中在中国（其次为俄罗斯及东亚、欧洲部分地区），现代综合重症救治下总病死率约<1%–3%（汉滩病毒型较汉城病毒型更重）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 2024年国家疾控局法定报告传染病显示全国报告流行性出血热4,259例、死亡12例（发病率0.3026/10万），陕西、黑龙江、国内部分地区、湖南等重点疫区高发，冬季及春季呈双峰特征。
annual_deaths_china.source: 国家疾病预防控制局 2024年全国法定传染病疫情概况 / China CDC Weekly 2025

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年报告数万例HFRS，中国在历史上及当前仍占全球报告病例的绝大多数，主要由啮齿类动物（黑线姬鼠、褐家鼠）经气溶胶、接触或消化道传播。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国属于乙类法定传染病重点防控区，每年报告数千例，呈明显农村秋收及冬春鼠媒季节性流行。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 发热早期即高度疑似并落实“三早一就”卧床休息（切忌长途颠簸）；严密监测血压、尿量及血小板/血红蛋白浓缩指标；低血压休克期快速以平衡盐晶体液及白蛋白/血浆扩容并短程去甲肾上腺素升压，避免过量补液诱发脑/肺水肿；少尿期严格“量出为入”，出现高血钾、尿毒症或高容量肺水肿立即行血液透析/CRRT治疗；防治腔道大出血。

master.definition_en: A rare genetic combined T and B cell immunodeficiency characterized by life-threatening infections due to disrupted transferrin receptor 1 endocytosis, resulting in defective cellular iron transport and impaired T and B cell function. Patients present with early-onset chronic diarrhea, severe recurrent infections, and failure to thrive. Laboratory studies reveal hypo- or agammaglobulinemia, normal lymphocyte counts but decreased numbers of memory B cells, intermittent neutropenia and thrombocytopenia, and mild anemia (resistant to iron supplementation) with low mean corpuscular volume.

master.definition_en: Congenital laryngeal palsy is a rare larynx anomaly characterized by unilateral or bilateral paralysis of the vocal cords as a result of dysfunction of the motor nerve supply to the larynx. Patients typically present at birth (or shortly thereafter) with stridor, weak or breathy cry, dysphonia or aphonia, feeding or aspiration difficulties and, occasionally, respiratory compromise. Neurological disease, masses that cause compression and aberrant vessels are often associated. Most cases resolve spontaneously over 6-12 months.

master.definition_en: Cutis verticis gyrata (CVG) is a progressive cutaneous disorder predominantly affecting males and characterized by hypertrophy and thickening of the skin of the scalp forming convoluted furrows with deep, tender, and cerebriform cutaneous folds. Hair is usually normal in the furrows and sparse on the folds. CG can be isolated (essential CVG) or associated with other abnormalities such as intellectual deficit, epilepsy, cataract, blindness, and deafness (non essential CVG).

master.definition_en: Leukodystrophies are a group of rare, progressive, metabolic, genetic diseases that affect the brain, spinal cord and often the peripheral nerves. Each type of leukodystrophy is caused by a specific gene abnormality that leads to abnormal development or destruction of the white matter (myelin sheath) of the brain. The myelin sheath is the protective covering of the nerve and nerves can't function normally without it. Each type of leukodystrophy affects a different part of the myelin sheath, leading to a range of neurological problems.

master.name_en: resistance to thyroid hormone due to a mutation in thyroid hormone receptor alpha
master.definition_en: A rare thyroid hormone signaling disorder characterized by a reduced T4/T3 ratio and normal levels of thyroid-stimulating hormone. The clinical phenotype variably includes neurodevelopmental delay (motor and cognitive), chronic constipation, anemia, disproportionate short stature and delayed bone age, skin tags, decreased metabolic rate, mild bradycardia, delayed teeth eruption and skeletal abnormalities. Dysmorphic craniofacial features, such as macrocephaly, coarse facies, flattened nasal bridge, macroglossia, and thick lips can be present. Disease manifestations may vary from very mild to severe.
synonyms_en: Resistance to thyroid hormone due to a mutation in TRa
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: TOR1AIP1-related multisystem disorder is a rare, early-onset disorder affecting multiple organ systems that is caused by variation in the TOR1AIP1 gene. Clinical features reported in affected individuals are variable but may include hypotonia, dystonia, cerebellar atrophy, contractures, cardiomyopathy, microcephaly, cataract, deafness, skeletal anomalies, progeroid appearance and other facial dysmorphism, and nephrolithiasis.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: An infectious disease caused by certain viruses or bacteria that can damage the walls of tiny blood vessels, making them leak, and can hamper the blood's ability to clot and cause severe, life-threatening illness.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑

master.name_en: NACC1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with epilepsy, cataracts and episodic irritability
master.definition_en: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by heterozygous variants in NACC1 and characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, epilepsy, cataracts, feeding difficulties, and recurring episodes of extreme irritability. Other phenotypes include hypotonia, delayed myelination, microcephaly, stereotypic hand movements, gastrointestinal tract issues, and sleeping problems.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
